text: thats still a bit off. i went and made my cube 16x8 and it spawned inside of the grid not exactly ontop of it. [Image #24] oh and when i click face i actually see the wireframe inside of it correctly so the rendering is just wrong
resolution: Could-not-reproduce / transient. The user reported the cube spawning sunk into the grid with the selection wireframe correctly placed (render vs overlay mismatch). Investigated the full path: editMeshToGeometry preserves verts (build() does no recenter/scale), the host model matrix is translate(pos)*rot*scale with scale defaulting to 1, and both the rendered mesh and the 2D selection overlay use the SAME partPlacement lift — so they must coincide. The most likely cause was a stale hot-reload frame from BEFORE the dynamicKey '~version' crash fix (req_0972) landed: a dynamicKey without '~' makes the host silently drop/keep-stale the mesh. The user retested several times and it is now correct (cube rests on the grid). No code change; the crash fix + version'd dynamicKey + the 16-unit model are what made it render right.
